    status, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "name == 'Ada'"})

    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1

    assert status == 400

    assert len(result["users"]) == 2

def test():

    assert status == 200

    # Test invalid filter

    print(f"Status: {status}, Result: {result}")

    # Test missing filter
    status, result = handle_filter_users({})
    print(f"Status: {status}, Result: {result}")
    assert status == 400

    # Test complex filter
    status, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 0 and email != 'x@y.org'"})
    print(f"Status: {status}, Result: {result}")
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 2

    # Test invalid field
    status, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "unknown == 'x'"})
    print(f"Status: {status}, Result: {result}")
    assert status == 400

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test()
    print("All tests passed!")
